name: Firm Capital Apartment Real Estate Investment Trust Units (FCA.UN)
summary: Firm Capital Apartment Real Estate Investment Trust is a US-focused trust that invests in income-producing multi-residential real estate and related debt, either wholly owned or through joint ventures. It holds apartment units in Florida, Connecticut, Texas, New York, Georgia and Maryland. It trades on the TSX Venture Exchange, has its head office in Toronto and was incorporated in Canada.
